# AND_SORTED vs AND_HASH plan stages — concept pack (small)

> Source-anchored research for AND_SORTED vs AND_HASH plan stages. Run status: COMPLETED.

<!-- generated by llms-concept-abstractor v1.4.1 · generated 2026-10-22 · budgeted to ≈8000 tokens; the full catalogue is llms-full.txt -->

## Structure and components

- [statement] AND_SORTED's “sorted” describes the RecordId order of its child streams, not the query's requested sort order. The MongoDB 6.0 manual allows intersection for some sorted queries when an index used for a predicate also supplies part of the sort; intersection does not apply when the sort needs an index wholly separate from the filter. (high confidence) — https://dev.to/franckpachot/mongodb-index-intersection-and-postgresql-bitmap-scan-40a6 · keywords: AND_SORTED vs AND_HASH plan stages · also: https://web.archive.org/web/2024/https://www.mongodb.com/docs/v6.0/core/index-intersection/

## How it works

- [statement] When explain shows AND_SORTED or AND_HASH in a plan, MongoDB is using index intersection. Inspect the winning plan and execution statistics to see which intersection strategy actually ran. (high confidence) — https://web.archive.org/web/2024/https://www.mongodb.com/docs/v6.0/core/index-intersection/ · keywords: AND_SORTED vs AND_HASH plan stages · also: https://oneuptime.com/blog/post/2026-03-31-mongodb-how-to-use-index-intersection-in-mongodb/markdown, https://mqlens.com/guides/read-mongodb-explain-plan/
- [statement] Index intersection is a candidate plan, not a guarantee: MongoDB can choose one IXSCAN instead. In source revision 35647d07, the plan ranker breaks ties in favor of single-index plans because intersection can examine more index keys; a compound index can constrain both predicates in one index traversal. (high confidence) — https://github.com/mongodb/mongo/blob/35647d07bc4bc11966c90fe7100eb1db0b0ac1d9/src/mongo/db/query/plan_ranker.h · keywords: AND_SORTED vs AND_HASH plan stages · also: https://dev.to/franckpachot/mongodb-index-intersection-and-postgresql-bitmap-scan-40a6, https://www.mongodb.com/community/forums/t/can-a-query-use-multiple-indexes/195726
- [statement] AND_SORTED assumes every child produces RecordIds in sorted order. It advances child streams toward a target RecordId and emits an ID when the required children reach that same ID. (high confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-22) — https://github.com/mongodb/mongo/blob/master/src/mongo/db/exec/classic/and_sorted.h · keywords: AND_SORTED vs AND_HASH plan stages · also: https://dev.to/franckpachot/mongodb-index-intersection-and-postgresql-bitmap-scan-40a6, https://oneuptime.com/blog/post/2026-03-31-mongodb-how-to-use-index-intersection-in-mongodb/markdown
- [statement] An intersection stage appears only when the planner selects an intersection candidate. In Franck Pachot's 100,000-document example, MongoDB generated an AND_SORTED candidate but selected a single-index plan. (high confidence) — https://dev.to/franckpachot/mongodb-index-intersection-and-postgresql-bitmap-scan-40a6 · keywords: AND_SORTED vs AND_HASH plan stages · also: https://oneuptime.com/blog/post/2026-03-31-mongodb-how-to-use-index-intersection-in-mongodb/markdown

## Problems, failure modes and limitations

- [statement] The current classic AndHashStage defaults to a 32 MiB buffer limit and raises QueryExceededMemoryLimitNoDiskUseAllowed when buffered usage exceeds the configured limit. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-22) — https://github.com/mongodb/mongo/blob/master/src/mongo/db/exec/classic/and_hash.cpp

## Facts and statements

- [statement] AND_SORTED and AND_HASH both intersect RecordId sets from separate index scans. AND_SORTED advances input streams that share RecordId order and can merge them incrementally. AND_HASH builds a hash table from one child scan and probes it with the other, so it must consume the build-side scan before it can return matches. (high confidence) — https://groups.google.com/g/mongodb-dev/c/j2Mp5zNU7T4 · keywords: AND_SORTED vs AND_HASH plan stages · also: https://oneuptime.com/blog/post/2026-03-31-mongodb-how-to-use-index-intersection-in-mongodb/markdown, https://dev.to/franckpachot/mongodb-index-intersection-and-postgresql-bitmap-scan-40a6
- [statement] MongoDB 6.0 documentation states hash-based intersection is disabled by default and sort-based intersection is disfavored in plan selection. Franck Pachot's article, edited 2026-03-09, also records the hash-intersection setting as false in its tested environment. Verify server version and internal settings before expecting AND_HASH. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-03-09) — https://web.archive.org/web/2024/https://www.mongodb.com/docs/v6.0/core/index-intersection/ · keywords: AND_SORTED vs AND_HASH plan stages · also: https://dev.to/franckpachot/mongodb-index-intersection-and-postgresql-bitmap-scan-40a6
- [statement] MongoDB issue SERVER-14961 records an index-intersection ranking regression specific to MongoDB 2.6.4 and says the fix shipped in 2.6.5; this historical incident does not establish current-version planner behavior. (low confidence) — https://jira.mongodb.org/browse/SERVER-14961
- [statement] AND_SORTED and AND_HASH implement index intersection by comparing RecordIds from their child stages and retaining matches shared across the children. (high confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-22) — https://github.com/mongodb/mongo/blob/master/src/mongo/db/exec/classic/and_sorted.h · keywords: AND_SORTED vs AND_HASH plan stages · also: https://github.com/mongodb/mongo/blob/master/src/mongo/db/exec/classic/and_hash.cpp, https://oneuptime.com/blog/post/2026-03-31-mongodb-how-to-use-index-intersection-in-mongodb/markdown
- [statement] AND_HASH builds a RecordId-keyed in-memory map from preceding children, then probes the final child. With two children, it reads the first child to completion before it can return matches from the second; this makes the stage blocking and its memory use proportional to buffered results. (high confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-22) — https://github.com/mongodb/mongo/blob/master/src/mongo/db/exec/classic/and_hash.cpp · keywords: AND_SORTED vs AND_HASH plan stages · also: https://groups.google.com/g/mongodb-dev/c/j2Mp5zNU7T4, https://dev.to/franckpachot/mongodb-index-intersection-and-postgresql-bitmap-scan-40a6
- [statement] The AND_SORTED ordering criterion applies to RecordIds. A query's requested field sort must be evaluated separately from the stage name. (high confidence) — https://github.com/mongodb/mongo/blob/master/src/mongo/db/exec/classic/and_sorted.h · keywords: AND_SORTED vs AND_HASH plan stages · also: https://dev.to/franckpachot/mongodb-index-intersection-and-postgresql-bitmap-scan-40a6, https://oneuptime.com/blog/post/2026-03-31-mongodb-how-to-use-index-intersection-in-mongodb/markdown
